mutants.name: dry-append-removed
mutants.why: removing the DRY-line append means --dry commits leave no register row; l6 asserts the register ends with the DRY line
mutants.anchor:
if args.dry and not register_changed:
        dry_line = (f"**Walk {walk_n} lens {lens_n} — {LENS_NAMES[lens_n]}"
                    f" — DRY, basis:** {desc}")
        register_path.write_text(
            register_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + dry_line + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

mutants.name: cycle-only-guard-removed
mutants.why: without the cycle-only check, --dry over a real body fold would proceed; l7b asserts refusal and the 'beyond its cycle record' message
mutants.anchor:
if not draft_cycle_only:
            print(f"LENS-COMMIT: record FAIL — --dry, but the draft changed beyond "
                  f"its cycle record: {first_offending}")
            return 1

mutants.name: no-row-refusal-removed
mutants.why: without the no-row check, a fold without a register row would silently commit; l7 asserts rc=1 and 'record FAIL'
mutants.anchor:
if not register_changed:
            print(f"LENS-COMMIT: record FAIL — the register carries no row for "
                  f"walk {walk_n} lens {lens_n}; write the fold row (§2.7), "
                  f"or pass --dry for a dry lens")
            return 1

mutants.name: draft-dropped-from-to-add
mutants.why: original bug: draft was absent from to_add; l8 asserts 'plan.md' in git show --name-only HEAD

mutants.name: duplicate-guard-removed
mutants.why: without the duplicate guard, running --dry twice writes two DRY lines; l10 asserts second run rc=1 and one DRY line

mutants.name: in-head-check-reverted-to-ls-files
mutants.why: ls-files answers the INDEX so a git-add'd-but-not-committed register passes it; l9 asserts refusal for a staged-only register
mutants.anchor:
r = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(root), "cat-file", "-e", f"HEAD:{register_rel}"],
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"LENS-COMMIT: record FAIL — {register_path.name} is not committed; "
              f"commit the walk-0 state first")
        return 1
mutants.replacement:
r = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo_dir), "ls-files", "--error-unmatch",
         str(register_resolved)],
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"LENS-COMMIT: record FAIL — {register_path.name} is not committed; "
              f"commit the walk-0 state first")
        return 1

mutants.name: vacuity-refusal-removed
mutants.why: without vacuity check, a mode-only change passes --dry silently; l11 asserts 'diff could not be read'

mutants.name: plumbing-flags-dropped
mutants.why: without -c color.ui=false -c diff.external= --no-color --no-ext-diff, the diff under color.ui=always carries no +/- content lines and the vacuity refusal fires where l7b's refusal is asserted

mutants.name: walk-shape-dropped-from-accepted-set
mutants.why: without the '**Walk N — ' pattern, the walk-closing per-walk summary line fails the cycle-only guard; l6b asserts rc=0
mutants.anchor:
r"^(?:"
    r"- (?:Weak spots|Destruction|Vulnerabilities|Integration-record|ACID):"
    r"|\*\*Walk \d+ — "   # em-dash
    r"|walks: \d+$"
    r")"

mutants.name: draft-from-fold-baseline-returns-none-always
mutants.why: if the helper always returns (None, None), a deposited copy can never reach the drafting repo's log; o1 asserts LENS-ORDER OK via fold_baseline

mutants.name: leading-dot-not-stripped
mutants.why: matching r'^(.*)\.foldcheck\.json$' instead of r'^\.(.*)...' includes the leading dot in the draft name; o1 asserts rc=0 (derived draft never found → time-merge → INCOMPLETE)

mutants.name: note-removed
mutants.why: without printing the NOTE, o4 cannot see 'fold_baseline resolved;' in stderr
mutants.anchor:
if note:
                    print(f"NOTE: fold_baseline resolved; {note}", file=sys.stderr)

mutants.name: identity-tie-removed
mutants.why: without the register-ref identity tie, a foreign baseline whose plan has all-5-lens commits would union in those commits and manufacture REPEATED; o5 asserts REPEATED not in stdout
mutants.anchor: if draft_ref and plan_ref and draft_ref == plan_ref:
mutants.replacement: if True:  # mutant: identity tie removed

mutants.name: osr-try-except-removed
mutants.why: without the OSError try/except, chmod-000 raises PermissionError uncaught → subprocess exit 1 as lens_order:0_breach; o4c asserts 'Traceback' not in stderr
